inherited.event_order: merge then prune then spawn, with at most one event per checkpoint

inherited.spawn_score: norm of orthogonalized <g_candidate|dPsi/dt+iHPsi> divided by sqrt(novelty)

operator.boundary: zero Dirichlet ghost values, one grid step beyond each axis
